name: Card
description: A surface container for grouping related content. Supports optional clickability with link or button semantics. Sub-components CardHeader, CardBody, and CardFooter provide semantic structure.

accessibility.role: varies — 'button' when clickable without href, link when clickable with href
notes: When clickable and href is provided, the card renders as an <a> element.
When clickable and onClick is provided (no href), the card renders as role='button' with tabIndex=0.
Enter and Space activate clickable cards.
Non-clickable cards have no interactive role.

clickable.description: When true, the card is interactive. Use href for navigation, onClick for actions.

href.description: When provided with clickable=true, renders the card as an <a> element.

onClick.description: Click handler. When clickable=true and no href, renders with role='button'.

padding.description: CSS custom property name (without --) for the card's internal padding. Must be a valid spacing token.

children.description: Card content. Use CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter sub-components for structure.

subcomponents.CardHeader: Renders a styled header area above card body content.
subcomponents.CardBody: Renders the primary content area of the card.
subcomponents.CardFooter: Renders a styled footer area below card body content.

do: Use CardHeader, CardBody, and CardFooter to structure content semantically.
Use href for cards that navigate to another page or route.
Use onClick for cards that trigger an action without navigation.
Ensure clickable cards always have a meaningful accessible name.
dont: Do not place interactive controls (buttons, links) inside a clickable card — this creates nested interactive elements.
Do not use Card for tabular or list data — use Table or List instead.
Do not change the padding token to a raw value.
